OAuth.title: Connect {client}
OAuth.subtitle: {client} wants to use your Sniptide account.
OAuth.read: Search and read your snippets, collections and env groups
OAuth.write: Create, edit and delete snippets, collections and env groups
OAuth.redirectNotice: After you allow access, Sniptide sends you back to {host}. Only continue if you started this from {client}.
OAuth.revokeNotice: You can disconnect it at any time in Settings, API tokens.
OAuth.invalidClient: The app that sent you here isn't registered with Sniptide. Start the connection again from the app.
OAuth.invalidRedirect: The app that sent you here asked to return to an address it didn't register. Start the connection again from the app.
OAuth.pitchBody: A connected app acts for you with the access you allow here and nothing more.
